input.quote: (e) disclose any Licensed Technology to, or permit the use or access of any Licensed Technology by any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee for use in the Field of Use.
input.rationale: The grant runs to Licensee alone and access is expressly limited to our employees, with sublicensing, outsourcing and service-bureau use barred — Affiliates and contractors are excluded with no path to add them, which is the walk-away case. We have added Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf (confidentiality-bound) to the grant and to the access restriction. We separately note the grant is conditioned on payment and terminable by Licensor on any breach, addressed under T4C.

input.quote: Licensee agrees to allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit and analyze appropriate accounting records to ensure compliance with all terms of this Agreement. Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
input.rationale: Audit frequency is unlimited — Licensor may demand audits at will — which fails even the fallback of once per year and sits in walk-away territory. The independent-auditor requirement, the 30-day lead time and the cost allocation (Licensor bears cost unless a 5% discrepancy, per p0064) are already at our preferred position; we have added the once-per-12-months, business-hours, confidentiality and no-system-access limits.

input.quote: NO DAMAGES FOR TERMINATION. NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
input.rationale: There are no liquidated damages, penalties or minimum-fee acceleration payable by us: Article XXIII expressly bars termination damages, and Licensor's retained right on early termination is limited to fees for trades actually performed. The audit cost-shifting on a 5% discrepancy is a customary reimbursement, not a penalty. Nothing to redline.
